rows.design: The scored curve is the uncapped equal-weight book (peak 92 names, median 21). An executable book sizes each new report at $30,000 and stops at 23 open names on the $700,000 paper pool, keeping the largest excess-return names and skipping the rest. That cap was not re-scored. Orders are the entry open and the stop or the hold-date close, not a monthly rebalance.
